text:
sana: heads-up: onboarding orsa-lite-int8 (ptq) on staging. seeing high silhouette variance and recall@5 regressed only for queries <12 tokens. logs attached. anyone have a quick checklist?
tom: short-query only regressions usually mean directional collapse after quant. is this per-tensor or per-channel?
sana: per-tensor symmetric, calibrating with eval batch of 64. baseline fp recall@5=0.69, int8 recall@5=0.51, silhouette fp=0.38 -> int8=0.22.
june: try reducing calib batch size and enabling per-channel. also compute embedding norms breakdown by length bucket.
mike: also try adding a whitening/mean-center preproc in the eval path; sometimes quant shifts the mean and kmeans gets confused.
sana: ran quick ablations: batch=16 + per-channel -> recall@5 short queries 0.51 -> 0.62, silhouette -> 0.30. whitening toggle gave tiny lift to silhouette but more stable centroids.
eval-bot: run summary for 3742101010:
```
model: orsa-lite-int8 (onnx ptq)
dataset: onboard-mini (3k queries)
metrics:
  recall@1: fp=0.41 -> int8=0.30
  recall@5: fp=0.69 -> int8=0.51
  recall@5 (<=12 tokens): fp=0.72 -> int8=0.51
  recall@5 (>50 tokens): fp=0.65 -> int8=0.63
  silhouette: fp=0.38 -> int8=0.22
  avg-l2: fp=1.08 -> int8=0.80
notes: norm compression + higher variance in clustering for short queries. per-channel improves but not fully recovered. whitening helps centroid stability.
```
june: sounds like a calibration artifact. next steps: 1) try dynamic range clamp using 512 random samples, 2) run a k (clusters) sweep to see if silhouette changes are sensitive to k, 3) add short-query holdout to onboard checklist.
tom: add KV-cache aware quant test too (simulate longer prefix for contrast). sometimes prefix attention causes different activation ranges.
sana: opened PR with per-channel calib + whitening flag: https://git.redwood/orsa/PR-2199. will run 24h synthetic after we confirm short-query bucket >=0.65 recall@5.
mike: if per-channel + clamp still leaves gap, consider tiny-scale re-centering layer (post-embed affine) as last resort.
sana: thanks team. I'll post updated eval-bot results here once PR merges. :rocket:
